name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The project hosts a Proven and Probable Mineral Reserve of 42.3 Mt grading 91 g/t Ag and 0.81 g/t Au, containing approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold. The company graduated from the TSX Venture Exchange to the Toronto Stock Exchange in February 2025 and is advancing Diablillos toward a development decision.
